BE-30

BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Headlight Cleaner

4. INSPECT MOTOR
(a) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 1 and the negative (—) lead to terminal 3.
(b) Check that the motor operates.
NOTICE: These tests must be performed quickly (within 3 — 5 seconds) to prevent the coil from burning out.
If operation is not as specified, replace the motor.
